title: Vector and Horizon
author: Wendell Ishikawa
blurb: Bram Zhou, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
